name: AZ-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+4 district lean in a favorable Democratic environment
Jasser's modest fundraising and no outside spending
model.rationale: Stanton is a well-funded incumbent in a D+4 seat, outraising Jasser roughly four to one with no outside opposition spending, and markets price his reelection near 97%. With no polls or expert ratings to move the call, fundamentals support a Safe D rating near the baseline margin.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Stanton or a sharply worse national environment for Democrats could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Greg Stanton seeks a third term in this Phoenix-area district, which leans Democratic by about four points. He has raised over $2.1 million and holds $2 million on hand, while Republican Zuhdi Jasser has raised under $600,000 and drawn no outside support or opposition spending. A Libertarian candidate is also on the ballot but has shown little financial activity.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals: the district lean, a favorable national environment for Democrats, Stanton's incumbency, and his clear financial edge. Prediction markets price Stanton's chances near 97%, consistent with a Safe Democratic rating and an expected winning margin in the high teens.
